notes: Shirotae-machi becomes the Town of Ice Lanterns: hundreds of ice lanterns that glow at night, snow walls along the street, kamakura snow huts with candles inside, a giant Snow Koi sculpture at the gate (read its little sign), festival lanterns strung across the street, fluttering banners, chimney smoke, a roast-chestnut stall, snowmen, white storehouses, and houses of every size instead of a grid. Also: real mountain ranges ring the horizon, day and night, so the world never ends at a cut edge.
